angola.definition: n. a republic in southwestern Africa on the Atlantic Ocean; achieved independence from Portugal in 1975 and was the scene of civil war until 1990

angolamycin.translation:
[化] 安哥拉霉素
[医] 安哥拉霉素

angolan.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Angola
a. of or relating to or characteristic of Angola or its people

angolans.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Angola
angolans.translation:
a. 安哥拉的；安哥拉人的
n. 安哥拉人(或居民)

angolese.translation: n. 安哥拉土人；安哥拉土人语

angor.definition:
n. Great anxiety accompanied by painful constriction at the
   upper part of the belly, often with palpitation and oppression.
angor.translation: n. 极为痛苦, 绞痛

angora.definition:
n. a domestic breed of goat raised for its long silky hair which is the true mohair
n. domestic breed of rabbit with long white silky hair
n. a long-haired breed of cat similar to the Persian cat
angora.translation: n. 安哥拉, 安哥拉猫, 安哥拉山羊, 马海毛

angoras.definition:
plural of Angora
n. a domestic breed of goat raised for its long silky hair which is the true mohair
n. domestic breed of rabbit with long white silky hair
n. a long-haired breed of cat similar to the Persian cat
angoras.translation: (Angora 的复数) n. 安哥拉, 安哥拉猫, 安哥拉山羊, 马海毛

angostura.definition: n the bitter bark of a South American tree; used in medicines and liqueurs and bitters
angostura.translation:
n. 安古斯图拉树皮, 安古斯图拉树皮制剂
[医] 安古斯图腊[树]皮(苦补药、兴奋药)

angostura bark.definition:
An aromatic bark used as a tonic, obtained from a
   South American of the rue family (Galipea cusparia, / officinalis).

angostura bitters.translation: 安古斯图拉树皮制剂（商标名）

angosturine.translation:
[化] 安果斯都拉树皮碱
[医] 安古斯图腊硷

angoumois.translation: n. 昂古穆瓦（法国旧省）
